inMemoryListQueries.label: Small collection (server-side list queries)
inMemoryListQueries.hint: List filter, text search, and sort run on the API without extra Firestore list indexes. A short-lived server cache (CACHE_TTL_MS) avoids re-reading Firestore on each request. Uses the global document cap (CLIENT_QUERY_FALLBACK_MAX_DOCS). Field filter/sort options stay enabled in the UI.
inMemoryListQueries.indexPlanDescription: Minimal Firestore indexes (baseline and relation lookups only). Filter, search, and sort use one server-side in-memory pipeline within the global document cap.
